issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Developer: The problem statement and the template expect a two-parameter initializer init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?), but the solution introduces a third parameter age (init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int)). Furthermore, the solution's Client still calls the two-parameter initializer. This creates an internal contradiction in the solution repository and a cross-artifact mismatch with the problem/template. Students following the problem or template would expect to implement and use a two-parameter initializer; the extra parameter in the solution (and the solution's inconsistent Client) will confuse students and prevents the provided solution from compiling as-is.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution's Developer initializer match the problem statement and template by removing the extraneous age parameter: change init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int) to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). Then update the initializer body accordingly (assign parameters to properties and print the description). Alternatively, if the age parameter is intentionally required, update the problem statement and all template and client calls to include and document the age parameter consistently. The preferred fix is to remove age from the solution so solution, template, and problem stay consistent.
